sloka: एवमुक्त्वा तु विरते रामे वचनमर्थवत् ।ततो मन्दाकिनीतीरे रामं प्रकृतिवत्सलम् ।उवाच भरतश्चित्रं धार्मिको धार्मिकं वच: ॥ २.१०६.१॥
transliteration: evamuktvā tu virate rāme vacanamarthavat ।tato mandākinītīre rāmaṁ prakṛtivatsalam ।uvāca bharataścitraṁ dhārmiko dhārmikaṁ vaca: ॥ 2.106.1॥

translations.english: Rama remained silent after saying these meaningful words on the bank of river Mandakini. Then the Bharata, conforming to righteousness, replied in clear words to the virtuous Rama who was affectionate by nature.
